an1.21:1.1: The mind “developed” by way of the absorptions is “workable” ([an3.58:5.1]()), but it becomes “unworkable” due to the five hindrances ([sn46.33]()). | This chapter breaks from the pattern of the previous two, in that it is not produced from a set of five. It begins a longer series of discourses mostly marked by the term “this mind”, which concludes at [an1.52]().
an1.25:1.1: Here, _pātubhūta_ (“manifested”) is a synonym for “developed”, in reference to the realization of untapped potential. [an4.162]() speaks of the degree of manifestation of the faculties.
